description: Open a new point of sale — the cabinet’s Add Outlet form. Name and the full street address (address, city, state, postCode) are all REQUIRED, exactly as on that form. Do NOT try to set a country: every outlet inherits the company’s country, and it can never be changed per outlet. Ask the merchant for any part of the address you do not know — an invented address ends up on receipts. This is BILLABLE: a new outlet counts against the company plan’s outlet allowance and the call is refused once that allowance is used up. Confirm with the merchant before calling. Afterwards the platform seeds a stock row of 0 for every product at the new outlet in the background, so its stock reads as empty until someone receives or transfers stock in. Linking a Stripe account to the outlet is NOT possible from here — the merchant does that in Settings → Outlets.

address.description: Street address, e.g. "123 King St W"

alias.description: Short code used by the WooCommerce / Metorik integration. Can never be changed once set — leave it out unless the merchant asked for it

name.description: Outlet name as the merchant calls it, e.g. "King Street"

taxId.description: Business tax number printed on this outlet’s receipts (BN / GST / HST / VAT / EIN)
